description: Join us for the Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social—a relaxed, welcoming gathering designed for anyone in Lisbon’s vibrant startup and professional community who wants to connect beyond the usual business talk. Hosted by Richard and Naren and the friendly Open Coffee Lisbon team, this event is all about genuine conversations, new friendships, and building a supportive network in a laid-back atmosphere. Many of our current event participants head out for lunch to hang out after our sell out morning meetings. We decided to offer a more social event in fabulous setting. Whether you’re an entrepreneur, student, creative, tourist, or simply curious, you’ll find a space where everyone is encouraged to mingle, share stories, and discover common interests. Our events are open and welcoming to people from all backgrounds and ages. Many different nationalities come together at our events, as well as long term Lisbon residents. Our motto "we welcome all, who welcome all." **This is not a speed dating/pickup type event. Everyone who attends is entitled to feel safe, not be harassed or pressured.** EVENT STRUCTURE: We will have a structured first sixty minutes with icebreakers aimed at making things easy for people to connect with one another. Then participants are welcome to hang out and socialise as they wish after the structured part of the meeting is over. Bring your ideas, your curiosity, and your favourite conversation starters. Share your LinkedIn or project links with the group, and let’s help each other grow—personally and professionally. This evening is about making connections that matter, all in a friendly, inclusive setting. If you’d like to help shape future gatherings or feature in our community newsletter, let us know. Open Coffee Lisbon is a friendly informal networking event for entrepreneurs, professionals, locals, guests, people in the startup community, and students in Lisbon.⁣ Your hosts for our event will be Richard and Giselle, with support from the Open Coffee Lisbon team. You may find a mentor, investor, client, co founder, employer, vendor, inspiration or a friend. Please post your contact details, a link to your Linkedin and/webpage in this group chat, and in our WhatsApp group https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY?mode=gi_t [here](https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY?mode=gi_t)[ ](https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY) We start at 09:30 AM sharp. Everybody gets up to 2 minutes to present: 1. Who they are and what they are doing 2. What they want 3. How they can help others At 10:30 AM we stop hosting and you can chat and network with the people who are most interesting to you. We are focused on business and social entrepreneurs, the startup community and anyone else who is doing something interesting or wants to get involved in other people's projects. You can talk about any project/topic. Open Coffee Lisbon is an “un-meeting” without a speaker or agenda. We are focused on attendees gaining value from other attendees. The rules, tools, structure and moderation aim to facilitate this goal. ⁣⁣What is the BIG idea behind Open Coffee? We want to help people create useful business connections.⁣ Everyone is welcome to our meetings, and we especially love first-timers.⁣ ⁣We want to make sure that if somebody coming from an unsupportive background/country has the courage to join, they will notice that we are glad they came because we welcome them. If you feel shy, you can also just listen but we encourage you to talk. Each attendee can also get to show their LinkedIn page or website through our channels and showcase their idea.⁣ This event is based on the Open Coffee Krakow format, run by Richard Lucas and others in Krakow Poland since 2012. title: THE PEOPLE OF LISBON SNAP ELECTION!
description: Hello People Of Lisbon, we're calling a snap election! Nobody asked for one, nobody knows why, and there are absolutely no positions of power up for grabs. But we do think it's a very good excuse to get everyone together for a few drinks. On Thursday, October 29th, we're taking over Absent for a good old-fashioned People Of Lisbon free for all gathering. It's been a while since we had one. For those who don't know us, People Of Lisbon started as a simple idea: tell the stories of the fascinating people who make this city what it is. Six years and more than 225 films later, we've become something much bigger. We make documentaries, take beautiful portraits, publish stories, produce podcasts, organise gatherings and run a growing community called Club People Of Lisbon. (Join the club... www.peopleoflisbon.com ) Whether you've appeared in one of our films, you're a member of our club, you've been following our adventures for years, you've just arrived in Lisbon or you've never heard of us before, you're invited. Come alone, bring a friend, bring five friends. All nationalities, ages, backgrounds and political persuasions welcome. Our election manifesto is simple: more friendships, more community, more interesting conversations and more reasons to love Lisbon.
